scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberate Tol colorblind-safe palette, white-halo canvas rendering, and sparkline distribution table all show clear design intent, but at 150 lines the parallel coords is maximally dense with little visual signal.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Parallel-coord axes use data-driven d3.extent domains and sparkline histograms have a correct zero baseline, but the 24-threshold bin count is hardcoded rather than derived via Sturges' or Scott's rule, making bin widths arbitrary across different datasets.
scores.stress_test_note: Both the brush ('brush end' handler fires on every pointermove) and strum (pointermove → updateSelection) trigger a full canvas redraw plus DOM data-join table update on every frame with no RAF coalescing, dirty flag, or throttle; no other interaction traps present (pointer events unify mouse/touch, no transitions risk mid-flight snap, no cross-view dispatch to cause feedback loops, and scales are static so no stale closure risk).
scores.cognitive_load_note: Two-view layout (parallel coords + sparkline table) stays within working memory limits; 150 lines create density noise in the middle axes but canvas alpha-blending and the unselected-gray/selected-color contrast manage it, and the 6-color Tol palette remains distinguishable throughout.

proposer: Added a white halo pass (4px wide, 0.25 alpha) behind the foreground lines before drawing the colored strokes. This creates visual separation between individual paths, making regional patterns traceable without needing to brush first. The background lines remain at 0.1 alpha, and the foreground bumped slightly to 0.55 alpha.
